section.title: Context compaction
section.subtitle: When history gets too long, the earlier part folds into one summary
field.keepRecent.label: Recent messages kept after compaction
field.keepRecent.help: Earlier history folds into the summary and these stay verbatim: a larger number means the model sees more original text afterwards and less context is freed.
field.autoCompactPercent.label: Auto-compaction trigger (percent of the model's context window)
field.autoCompactPercent.help: Compaction starts once the estimate passes this share; a manual /compact is not bound by it. The threshold is also pulled down by “window minus output reserve minus headroom”, and the lower of the two wins.
field.headroomTokens.label: Headroom (tokens, 0 = derived from the window)
field.headroomTokens.help: How early compaction starts: the threshold adds this much headroom on top of the output reserve (the model's maxTokens). 0 = automatic (6.4% of the window, at most 65536). Larger = compact earlier and leave more room for this turn; smaller = compact later and keep more history.
field.compactionRetries.label: Extra passes when one is not enough
field.compactionRetries.help: If the estimate is still above the threshold after an automatic compaction, it runs again, up to this many extra passes. The cost: every extra pass is another summary-model call (the real request waits for it), and each one folds more original text into the summary, so details are lost another layer down. 0 = one pass only.
field.retainPercent.label: Tail kept (percent of the model window)
field.retainPercent.help: The most recent exchanges stay verbatim after compaction, converted to a token budget from the model window and then stepped back to the safe boundary where a tool call and its result are never split; “recent messages kept after compaction” still applies as a minimum count. Why count tokens: one tool result can be hundreds of thousands of characters, and a count-only rule cannot compact such a session. Larger = more original text kept, less context freed.
field.anchorBudgetChars.label: Anchor index character budget
field.anchorBudgetChars.help: The summary carries a regex-extracted list of PR numbers / SHAs / file paths / raw error text that the model never rewrites. Larger lists more of them and takes more context.
field.userQuoteBudgetChars.label: User quote character budget
field.userQuoteBudgetChars.help: Compaction copies the most recent real user messages into the summary word for word, because a paraphrase the model wrote may drift from what was said. Larger quotes more and takes more context.
field.readStateFiles.label: read-state files
field.readStateFiles.help: The summary carries a list of which files were read last before compaction and up to which range, so picking the work up needs no re-reading. This is how many files it lists at most (0 = omit the section).
field.readStateChars.label: read-state character budget
field.readStateChars.help: Character cap for the whole read-state list; files that do not fit are dropped and marked as omitted. The list carries paths and line ranges only, never file contents.
